disposition.basis: The second failure occurred before commit, implementation, reservation, attempt, report, market-data read, or strategy observation. The same campaign identity remains permitted under the frozen pre-execution repair rule.
disposition.next_action: Commit a replacement source-bound pre-design packet that admits the exact cost model and review and requires separate cross-scenario signal/decision and scenario-specific execution traces, then assign another fresh no-history architect.

findings.finding: The allowed input set omitted the bound execution-cost model and its review even though the design used exact stress-delay semantics supplied by that model.
findings.required_remediation: Reject the plan and bind the cost-model artifact and review as allowed inputs before another fresh architect begins.

findings.finding: The design put intended fill index in the trace required to equal Normal across scenarios, making every non-Normal delay differ by construction.
findings.required_remediation: Require one scenario-independent pre-fill signal/decision trace for cross-scenario equality and retention plus one scenario-specific execution trace containing the intended fill index.

findings.finding: The trace hash was listed inside its own canonical preimage.
findings.required_remediation: Require each trace hash to be an output excluded from its explicitly versioned canonical payload.
